appDescription: Temporarily adjusts supported vehicle comfort settings and conditionally restores them while preserving manual changes.

function.name: FORNOW_TEMPORARY_SETTING
function.description: Temporarily applies one requested comfort setting for a specified duration and restores it unless manually changed.

control.description: fan lowers airflow, seatHeat enables low driver-seat heating, seatCool enables low driver-seat ventilation, wheel enables low steering-wheel heating, and ambient dims lighting.

durationSeconds.description: Duration in seconds, limited to 60, 180, or 300.

function.name: FORNOW_RESTORE_SETTINGS
function.description: Ends the current temporary or automatic session and conditionally restores settings that the user has not changed.

function.name: FORNOW_AUTOMATIC_MODE
function.description: Enables call and drive-through detection while parked, or disables it and restores unchanged settings.

enabled.description: Whether automatic detection should be enabled.
